address: 127, Section 1, Beixin Road, Xindian District, New Taipei, Taiwan
bio: This bright, airy room with an open kitchen by the entrance stands out on a street lined with older residential buildings. Smoked goose is the signature here – meticulously sliced and always tasty. You can order a specific number of portions or specify which cuts you prefer. It opens for four hours daily and the goose tends to run out before 1 pm. Generous table spacing and partitioned semi-private spaces ensure privacy and comfort.
